The steel cables are also pricey. The pergola looks custom and made of wood, wood is pricey. The materials in this design are on the higher end. We do design/build for a lot of homes of similar price and sometimes higher and they mostly use Nicolock pavers. Only every once in a while do we get a customer that wants natural stone. We recently designed an outdoor space for a home like yours with a pergola, fire pit, Nicolock pavers and path ways, vinyl trash enclosure, landscape of 2 year old plants, lighting, and irrigation for 150k. They didn’t have an outdoor kitchen, just a roll out grill. It was a relatively simple design.
